title: mnesithea selloana
intro: Mnesithea selloana, commonly known as Piquia, is a plant species in the Malpighiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Mnesithea selloana include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may aid in wound healing and skin protection. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
